Cover page: DisGeNET: a comprehensive resource for human disease-gene prioritization.

DisGeNET: 1) is an integrated discovery platform that provides a comprehensive view of human disease genes and their molecular functions and pathways; 2) is one of the largest collections of human gene-to-disease associations available; 3) is an open access repository; and 4) provides a variety of tools to facilitate the exploration of its content and to integrate it with other data sources.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of computational and statistical methods for the analysis and interpretation of high-throughput data in the context of human disease.
the identification and prioritization of genes involved in human genetic diseases.
understanding the genetic basis of human diseases and how this knowledge can be applied to improve human health.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DisGeNET is the most comprehensive resource available for the discovery and exploration of human disease genes.
DisGeNET is the best resource for exploring the molecular mechanisms underlying human diseases.
DisGeNET is an open access, comprehensive and integrative resource of human genes and their associations with diseases, disorders, traits and phenotypes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DisGeNET has become one of the most important repositories of gene-disease associations, with a unique combination of features that make it a very valuable resource.

DisGeNET provides the most comprehensive collection of human gene-diseases associations, which is freely available to researchers, health care practitioners, bioinformaticians and the general public, and that it is designed to meet the needs of different users.
we have built DisGeNET, a discovery platform for exploring the genetic underpinnings of human diseases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the DisGeNET database can be considered as a discovery platform, as it offers a wide variety of tools and services that can be used to address a variety questions concerning human genetic disease.

DisGeNET can provide the necessary support for a broad range of applications in the field of human genetics and genomics, from the identification of candidate disease genes, to the prioritization of genes in the context of genome-wide association studies, to the analysis of gene-gene interactions and to the prediction of drug targets.
we have built a comprehensive and open discovery platform that can be used by a variety of user profiles to address different types of questions.
